Sofia (CSM): Quick write-up from the VerityHealth kickoff — thanks to everyone who joined. Core ask: embed Redwood generation for discharge-summary drafts and patient-education by Day 30. High renewal risk flagged because this is a HIPAA workload and they want Private deployment + audit logs.

Dev (Solutions): Noted. Recommend a two-track plan: infra & compliance (security lead) + dev integration (SDK + sample flows). I'll own the integration examples.

Ibrahim (Onboarding): I'll set up three enablement slots: Dev lab, Ops walk-through, and Clinical-user review. Prefer next Wed/Thu.

Tara (CS Engineer): I'll provision a Private sandbox and run ingestion tests. Need their data retention policy and a small synthetic PHI-like dataset.

Priya (Verity Sec): We'll provide the data-retention doc by EOD Friday. For SSO they require SAML with attribute mapping + audit export. That will take ~6 business days to validate.

Miguel (Verity Eng): We'll parallelize the tokenization expectations and prompt safety checklist. Also want guidance on model quantization choices for latency/cost.

Sofia (CSM): Action list (owners + rough dates):
- Tara: Private sandbox ready + basic ingress tests (Day 7)
- Dev: SDK sample flows + error handling patterns (Day 4)
- Ibrahim: enablement slots scheduled + invite (Day 6)
- Priya: security & SSO requirements doc (Day 5)
- Miguel: synthetic dataset + tokenization notes (Day 3)

Dev (Solutions): Acceptance criteria for initial integration:
A) 3 clinician prompts produce acceptable summaries in staging (subjective QA pass)
B) 95th perc latency < 500ms under 3 RPS in sandbox
C) Audit logs captured for every API call (metadata + request id)
D) Security review sign-off or documented mitigations

Ibrahim (Onboarding): I'll also run a short pre/post enablement survey (2 q's) to measure confidence. Target: post-survey >= 4/5 average.

Tara (CS Engineer): Note: when running Private sandbox I'll enable strict egress rules and KMS integration. Need their KMS contact for key import.

Priya (Verity Sec): I'll share KMS contact and compliance checklist. Also: backup plan — if Private deploy timing slips, we propose a temporary VPC-hosted sandbox with contractual DPA controls. That reduces go-live risk but still requires legal ok.

Sofia (CSM): Good mitigation. Let's denote risk levels: HIPAA = high; SSO provisioning = medium-high; Dataset completeness = medium. We'll escalate to account exec if SSO isn't started by Thu.

Dev (Solutions): I'll draft a lightweight fallback: limit user scope, degrade to on-device templating for PII-heavy fields, and queue long-form generation for nightly batch while we stabilize. Draft by Day 8.

Miguel (Verity Eng): FYI — clinic workflows expect short summaries < 150 tokens. We'll test with 8 real-world prompts (anonymized) — sending examples later today.

calendar-bot: Event created: Verity Dev Lab — Wed 14:00 PT.

Sofia (CSM): Adding a high-level 30-day checklist here for the thread: 

30-day checklist (high-level)
Day 0-3: Kickoff actions, NDA/DPA check, obtain KMS contact, synthetic dataset
Day 4-7: SDK samples, Private sandbox provisioned, initial smoke tests
Day 8-14: SSO validation, audit log verification, performance tuning
Day 15-24: Clinical QA cycles, enablement sessions, capture feedback
Day 25-30: Go/no-go evaluation, legal & security sign-off, production cutover plan

Ibrahim (Onboarding): Will run the clinical-user review session on Day 18 and collect qualitative notes.

Tara (CS Engineer): I'll post staging perf numbers by Day 10. If we miss the latency SLA we'll apply a faster quantized variant and adjust batching.

Priya (Verity Sec): Please note we need a formal change request for any fallback that routes PHI to non-private endpoints.

Sofia (CSM): Understood. We'll keep PHI strictly in Private sandbox. All fallback plans must be approved.

Miguel (Verity Eng): :thumbsup:

Ibrahim (Onboarding): :thumbsup:

Tara (CS Engineer): :thumbsup: I'll link the sandbox access details once ready.

Dev (Solutions): :thumbsup: Drafting SDK snippets now.

Priya (Verity Sec): :thumbsup: Sharing doc later today.

Sofia (CSM): Next sync Mon 09:00 PT to validate Day 3 dataset and Day 7 provisioning. I'll post Notion link and invite. If SSO isn't initiated by Thu we escalate.

Sofia (CSM): Thanks team — capturing renewal risk: compliance gating + timeline. Will follow up with account exec if blockers surface by mid-week.
